cpmplus.w5cmds.menu.sheet.desc: Shows the right commands for every animation (/cpmclient animate, /cpm animate, /cpm detect), the names that need quotes and the gesture wheel order. Changes nothing in the project.
cpmplus.w5cmds.menu.rename: Rename names that mix up in game…
cpmplus.w5cmds.menu.rename.desc: Lists the animations whose names become the same button in game and lets you rename them (Ctrl+Z undoes)
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.title: Commands and gesture wheel
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.intro: These are the names the game will use, taken from the export itself. Copy the lines from here: Minecraft's autocomplete does not add the quotes. Nothing in the project changes.
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.playerHint: Replace <player> with the player's name (in a command block, use @p). Upper and lower case matter in the names.
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.collisions: Names that mix up in game
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.collision: Two items are called "%s": in game the command only reaches one of them.
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.collision.group: The group "%s" has the same name as another button: exporting the model in game can fail.
cpmplus.w5cmds.order: The result depends on the order of the animation list.
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.empty: This model has no buttons (poses, gestures, toggles, sliders or lists).
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.serverNote: For the server or a command block to change it (/cpm animate), check "Command controlled" on the animation.
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.commandNote: Command controlled: only the server changes it (/cpm animate). Not in the wheel, and /cpmclient can't reach it.
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.value.toggle: Value at the end (optional): 0 = off, 1 = on. No number: toggles.
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.value.slider: Value at the end: 0 to %s (the slider maximum).
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.value.none.pose: No value: the command turns it on (and off when used again).
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.value.option: No value: picks this option of the list.
cpmplus.w5cmds.wheel.command: — command only, not in the wheel
cpmplus.w5cmds.sheet.staff.intro: This model changes size or attributes. The server only allows it when the staff enables it:
cpmplus.w5cmds.badge.quotes: Needs quotes: %s — Minecraft 1.13+ autocomplete does not add the quotes, copy it from here
cpmplus.w5cmds.badge.unusable.hint: Works in the gesture wheel, but commands/command blocks can't reach it. Rename it without quotes, backslashes and double spaces (or spaces at the start/end).
cpmplus.w5cmds.safeName.warn: Safe name copied (nothing was renamed). Note: renaming resets the players' saved choices and breaks existing command blocks.
cpmplus.w5cmds.warn.groupConflict.now: The group "%s" has the same name as another animation's button (%s). In game, exporting the model will fail ("Animation name conflict").
cpmplus.w5cmds.warn.groupConflict: The group "%s" has the same name as another animation's button (%s). Depending on the order, the in-game export fails or the button starts driving the list.
cpmplus.w5cmds.warn.groupVsOption: "%s" is the name of a group and also of an option (%s). In game the options get mixed up: one disappears or lands in the wrong list.
cpmplus.w5cmds.warn.emptyId: A name starting with # becomes a button without a name in game: %s.
cpmplus.w5cmds.warn.mix: "%s" is used by different things: %s. In game there is only one button "%s" and it plays the animations of all of them; the others do not appear.
cpmplus.w5cmds.warn.conflict.consequence: In game: exporting the model (.cpmmodel or skin) can fail.
cpmplus.w5cmds.warn.mix.consequence: In game: one of the buttons disappears and the other plays both animations.
cpmplus.w5cmds.warn.names: %s names need quotes in commands; %s don't work in commands.
cpmplus.w5cmds.warn.noModelId: %s options set to "Save between sessions" will not be remembered: the model ID is missing.
cpmplus.w5cmds.warn.renamed: Renamed since the last export? People using the model will lose the keybind/saved choice of "%s" (now "%s", %s).
cpmplus.w5cmds.warn.renamed.consequence: In game: keybinds and saved choices are stored by name.
cpmplus.w5cmds.fix.rename: Opens the rename dialog (nothing changes until you confirm)
cpmplus.w5cmds.fix.createId: Creates a model ID (can be undone from the notice that appears)
cpmplus.w5cmds.error.conflict: The layer group "%s" has the same name as another button (pose, gesture, toggle or slider). Rename one of them (CPM+ > Animation > Rename names that mix up in game) and export again.
cpmplus.w5cmds.rename.title: Rename names that mix up
cpmplus.w5cmds.rename.none: No name mixes up in game.
cpmplus.w5cmds.rename.nothing: These animations are not in the project any more (deleted?).
cpmplus.w5cmds.rename.field.desc: Only the button name (before the #). What follows the # and the linked start/end animations change along.
cpmplus.w5cmds.rename.warnCommand: Renaming changes the name used by /cpm animate and in commands.
cpmplus.w5cmds.rename.warnSaved: People already using the model lose the keybind and saved choice of these buttons.
cpmplus.w5cmds.rename.invalid: The new name of "%s" can't be empty or contain #.
cpmplus.w5cmds.rename.stillMixed: "%s" still mixes up with another animation. Pick another name.
cpmplus.w5cmds.modelId.title: Model ID
cpmplus.w5cmds.modelId.about: Lets the game remember the options and keybinds of people using the model. Use the same ID in every version of this model.
cpmplus.w5cmds.modelId.generateBlocked: There already is an ID. To change it, clear the field by hand (players lose their saved choices).
cpmplus.w5cmds.modelId.nothingToCopy: The model has no ID yet.
cpmplus.w5cmds.modelId.warn: Changing or clearing the ID makes players lose their saved choices. This is not part of Ctrl+Z: use the "undo" of the notice that appears.
cpmplus.w5cmds.modelId.confirmChange: Players will lose their saved choices. Continue?
cpmplus.w5cmds.wizard.saveBetween: Save between sessions (the game remembers the choice)
cpmplus.w5cmds.wizard.needsId: For the game to remember, the model needs an ID.
